title: Support for You and the People You Care For: P&G and Care Out Loud Recognize Caregivers
summary: Find everyday essentials, free resources and community support from P&G, CVS and Care Out Loud this National Family Caregivers Month.
body_markdown:
## Care Starts Within: Supporting P&G Employee Caregivers


P&G’s commitment to caregivers also extends to its own employees. Through wellbeing resources and support, P&G aims to help employees navigate caregiving alongside the other demands of everyday life.


For Amy Delgado, a P&G Senior Manager of Analytics and Insights and caregiver to her daughter, flexibility and connection with others navigating similar experiences have been important parts of her own caregiving experience.


“When my daughter was born with Spina Bifida, it became clear that resources and supports were scarce for families who have children with disabilities. P&G has given me the flexibility I've needed to be present and care for both of my kids while also having a fulfilling career. What's even more of a gift is that working at P&G has allowed me to help others — through employee support groups, by being part of the universal design work that is making our products more accessible, and now by having the opportunity to shape how we learn from consumers who have disabilities to better serve their needs with our innovation.”
